name: Yuri Kido
source:
Human.
Star Sign: Sagittarius
Occupation: Samurai

A girl so expressionless it seems like she has no feelings, it's hard to guess what she's thinking.
Her way of speaking seems harsh, but she doesn't intend to be mean.
She's very serious and honest.
But whether she's an airhead or just lacks common sense, no matter how much you try to set her straight on certain things, she'll just keep making dumb comments.
